note: Closed vocabulary of mechanisms an example may claim to teach. Adding an entry is a deliberate act: it asserts a genuinely new thing an agent would come to an example to learn. Every example must own at least one mechanism no other example declares, or be recorded in example-mechanisms-policy.json with a reason.

runtime.auto-fit-text: Bounded text scaled to fit its box without losing content.
runtime.content-paging: More records than fit, cycled so every record is reachable.
runtime.timed-rotation: Instance-local timers advancing content, cleaned up on destroy.
runtime.bounded-transition: A page change that animates for a fixed duration and settles.
runtime.fixed-canvas-scaling: A reference-led composition scaled to fit with letterboxing.
runtime.published-map-package: A .wbmap runtime package consumed by the app.
runtime.platform-media-cache: Media resolved through the platform cache from a setting or row.
runtime.packaged-media: Media bundled with the app and listed in the resource list.
runtime.idle-screensaver: An attract state after inactivity, with its own branding and reset behaviour.
runtime.multi-timezone: Several places shown at once, each in its own local time.
runtime.manual-paging: Pages a viewer steps through by hand, stopping at the last page rather than wrapping.

capability.canonical-wayfinding-viewer: The versioned Wayfinding Studio mini-displayer consumed through the map-agnostic harness.
capability.on-screen-keyboard: Touch text entry bound to a field.
capability.charting: Chart.js or ECharts rendering sized for signage.

data.feed-or-calendar-binding: A native FEED or CALENDAR datasource.
data.multi-source-merge: Two or more datasources reconciled into one view.
data.internal-datasource-write: The app writing rows back to an internal datasource.
data.aggregate-of-submissions: A view deriving metrics from records another app wrote.
data.weather-binding: A weather datasource with its own failure states.
data.settings-only: No datasource at all: the app is driven entirely by settings and time.
data.scheduled-visibility: Rows appearing and expiring on their own schedule, with retention after expiry.
data.typed-column-formatting: Formatting driven by the datasource column type rather than by guesswork.
data.presence-binding: Live availability for named people from an identity or collaboration platform, where the state changes on its own rather than on a refresh cycle.

composition.dense-table-board: Many rows of uniform records read at distance.
composition.editorial-poster: Typographic composition with deliberate colour blocking.
composition.card-grid-mosaic: Asymmetric tiles of mixed media and text.
composition.split-stage: A dominant primary panel beside a subordinate column.
composition.ultra-wide-marquee: Continuous horizontal motion on a wide-low surface.
composition.tall-column-board: A narrow portrait column of grouped rows.
composition.status-wall: Uniform records whose state is the primary signal rather than their content.
composition.count-adaptive-layout: A different composition chosen by how many records exist, not by surface size.

interaction.directory-search: Search and filter across a browsable set.
interaction.guided-form: Stepped input with validation and submission.
interaction.custom-settings-editor: An editor surface beyond the property sidebar.
interaction.map-orientation: Selecting a destination and showing the way to it.
interaction.mobile-route-handoff: A QR link carrying a versioned semantic route state to a separate mobile wayfinding experience without exposing storage paths.
interaction.accessible-reach: A viewer-toggled layout that moves controls within reach and enlarges touch targets, for kiosks used from a seated height.

referenceExample.note: The example an agent should read first for this mechanism. Absent means no example is a standout, or none exists yet. Changing an entry is how a better teacher replaces an incumbent without either being deleted.
